messages:
Alex: heads up — thinking about an 'auto-snap' for console views: save a route+model+filter combo and have it automatically apply when you pick that route in the UI. would reduce clicks for SREs who always look at the same model on a route. cc @Maria @Sam
Maria: sounds useful. question: is this a UI-only affordance or do we want it to influence routing/telemetry backends? e.g., should selecting a view change sampling/quota hints sent to the router?
Sam: we need to be careful. if a view can change sampling or enable cost-preview it could unexpectedly spike telemetry or alter billing. i would prefer a read-only preview mode by default. any backend-changing flags should require explicit opt-in and an audit log.
Ryan: backend note — our saved_query schema is flat. to support route+model scoping + runtime hints we'd need: route_id, optional model_id, filters blob, sample_rate_hint, quota_bucket_hint, and a feature-flagged rollout_state. that implies a small API contract change: POST /api/views -> {"route_id": "..","scope": "route+model","filters": [...],"hints": {"sample_rate":"0.2","quota":"preview"}}.
Alex: example payload i'm imagining (pseudo):
```
POST /api/views
{
  "route_id": "route-123",
  "scope": "route+model",
  "model_id": "m-13b-quant",
  "filters": [{"field":"status","op":"=","value":"500"}],
  "hints": {"sample_rate":"0.05","cost_preview":true}
}
```
Maria: UX question — precedence. If both a user-level view and a team-level view match a route, which applies? propose precedence: explicit user pin > most-recently-saved-user > team-shared > org-default. show a pill in UI indicating which view is active and allow quick switch.
Sam: rollout/gating ops: when a view contains a sample_rate or quota hint we should not immediately apply it org-wide. need rollout API: start at 0.1% routes, monitor telemetry delta, then ramp. that requires storing a rollout_state per-view and a control-plane job to manage ramps. also need telemetry gating so we don't pollute eval dashboards.
Ryan: migration risk: adding fields to views will need a migration for older rows. propose v2 table saved_views_v2 with a feature flag (savedviews_v2). soft-migrate reads from old table if v2 flag off, write-through on create. plan for a background copy once flag toggled.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature-flag savedviews_v2 -> staging at 10:32 UTC :rocket:
Alex: ok — to summarize actions: i'll draft a short product spec that includes the payload and UX mock (preview-only by default). @Ryan can you draft the migration plan and API contract? @Sam add rollout + telemetry gating steps to the ops checklist. can we sync tomorrow 11am to walk the spec? :calendar:
